answer: Audits are logged in tide, queued in sable, and inlet publishes the wait time. A farm of 50 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 77 identities per epoch. A farm of 2470 identities would post 3837 proofs and burn roughly 16 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
